type: Original social app welcome campaign artwork
goal: Create a production bitmap hero asset, not a screenshot, for a native social voice/video app welcome page. Make it feel like meeting real people, confident contemporary editorial design.

brand.industry: Adult friendship, voice and video conversations
brand.name: Do not display any brand or app name

visual_tone.aesthetic: Candid photographic portrait collage, independent youth culture magazine, warm human connection, elegantly asymmetric, tactile photographic prints. Absolutely no glossy 3D interface styling.
visual_tone.color_palette: Deep green-black #102522 background, natural warm skin tones, fresh mint #B9EDCE accents, cream clothing, tiny restrained coral accent.
visual_tone.lighting: Soft window light, candid flash photography, genuine relaxed expressions, natural skin detail

centerpiece.type: Original fictional adult friends in three photographic portrait windows
centerpiece.description: Large slightly tilted portrait of a smiling 26-year-old woman with shoulder-length dark hair wearing a cream top, occupying left-center; a smaller portrait at upper right of a 28-year-old man with curly dark hair, medium brown skin, listening with headphones, laughing naturally; a small lower-right candid portrait of a 25-year-old Black woman with braids and a seafoam shirt waving hello. All fully clothed, casual, not glamour models. Faces in central safe area; social video conversation energy. Picture windows have subtly rounded corners as part of this raster artwork, uneven overlaps, one small original flat mint speech-bubble sticker bridging the pictures, with no text. Portrait arrangement feels composed and spacious, not a collage template.
centerpiece.scale: People and prints occupy 82% of width and 80% of height. Leave all four edges clean solid #102522, especially bottom 12% clean solid dark for a seamless transition into native copy below.

slogan.main: NO TEXT. Native app will draw all text.

logo_placement.position: No logo, no app name, no wordmark

must_keep: Faces sharp and warm, realistic editorial photography
Entire outer border uniform #102522 with no texture at edges
No smartphone frames or app controls
Strong asymmetrical composition with larger left portrait
avoid: Text, letters, numbers, watermarks, brand names
Heavy plastic bevels, glossy bubbles, huge shadows
Live indicators, fake names, follower counts
